icon16.label: Item icon · 16 × 16
icon16.note: Inventory and loot icons, drawn at 16 × 16 and shown at 3× (the prototype's size).

char.label: Character · 48 × 52, feet at (24, 43)
char.note: A survivor or one of the dead for the raid map: about 30 px tall, feet on the pivot, facing SE first (then SW, NW, NE).

hex.label: State Map hex · pointy top · 48 × 56
hex.note: One terrain tile for the State Map, pointy top in odd-r rows like the prototype. Rows overlap by a quarter of the height.

isofloor.label: Raid floor · iso 2:1 · 32 × 16 (1 m)
isofloor.note: One 1 m cell of floor for raid maps. Draw edges 2 across for 1 down so neighbours meet cleanly.

isoblock.label: Raid wall cell · 32 × 50 (34 px wall)
isoblock.note: A full-height cell: a 32 × 16 top face over a 34 px wall, the prototype's wall height. Top face first, then the two sides.
